title: Future Juice Blue Raspberry Candy Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Blue Raspberry Candy is a bold and tangy fusion of juicy Blue Raspberry with a smooth confectionery finish. The bright, mouth-puckering tartness of Blue Raspberry is perfectly balanced by a sugary sweetness, recreating the nostalgic taste of classic fruit-flavoured treats. This well-rounded blend delivers a lively and satisfying vape that lingers on the palate with its vibrant, fruity character. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and rich, full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a punchy, fruit-forward vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
